h: Blessing CEO tearfully talks about her late son and what he reportedly told the family
p: Content creator Blessing CEO has reportedly spoken tearfully about her late son, saying he told the family he had dreamt he would die. The interview has drawn sympathetic reactions online.
more: She is also facing a fraud case in court.
The interview follows her earlier comments about her time in custody.
Many viewers have sent messages of support.
alt: Blessing CEO in a dark green satin top, resting her chin on her hand
